versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֨ר אֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְיָרֵ֤ם אֶת־הַמַּחְתֹּת֙ מִבֵּ֣ין הַשְּׂרֵפָ֔ה וְאֶת־הָאֵ֖שׁ זְרֵה־הָ֑לְאָה כִּ֖י קָדֵֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,
controles.kjv: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
controles.livre: Dize a Eleazar, filho de Arão sacerdote, que tome os incensários do meio do incêndio, e derrame mais ali o fogo; porque são santificados:

versos.hebraico: אֵ֡ת מַחְתּוֹת֩ הַֽחַטָּאִ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה בְּנַפְשֹׁתָ֗ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ אֹתָ֜ם רִקֻּעֵ֤י פַחִים֙ צִפּ֣וּי לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כִּֽי־הִקְרִיבֻ֥ם לִפְנֵֽי־יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּקְדָּ֑שׁוּ וְיִֽהְי֥וּ לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives. Let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”
controles.kjv: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Os incensários destes pecadores contra suas almas: e farão deles placas estendidas para cobrir o altar: porquanto ofereceram com eles diante do SENHOR, são santificados; e serão por sinal aos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מַחְתּ֣וֹת הַנְּחֹ֔שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יבוּ הַשְּׂרֻפִ֑ים וַֽיְרַקְּע֖וּם צִפּ֥וּי לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
controles.kjv: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
controles.livre: E o sacerdote Eleazar tomou os incensários de bronze com que os queimados haviam oferecido; e estenderam-nos para cobrir o altar,

versos.hebraico: זִכָּר֞וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ֠מַעַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יִקְרַ֜ב אִ֣ישׁ זָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א מִזֶּ֤רַע אַהֲרֹן֙ ה֔וּא לְהַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֖רֶת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֤ה כְקֹ֨רַח֙ וְכַ֣עֲדָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the seed of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah, and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.
controles.kjv: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: Em memorial aos filhos de Israel que nenhum estranho que não seja da descendência de Arão, chegue a oferecer incenso diante do SENHOR, para que não seja como Coré, e como seu grupo; segundo se o disse o SENHOR por meio de Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּלֹּ֜נוּ כָּל־עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת עַל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֥ם הֲמִתֶּ֖ם אֶת־עַ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”
controles.kjv: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.
controles.livre: No dia seguinte toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel murmurou contra Moisés e Arão, dizendo: Vós haveis matado ao povo do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י בְּהִקָּהֵ֤ל הָֽעֵדָה֙ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה כִסָּ֖הוּ הֶעָנָ֑ן וַיֵּרָ֖א כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, They looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando se juntou a congregação contra Moisés e Arão, olharam até o tabernáculo do testemunho, e eis que a nuvem o havia coberto, e apareceu a glória do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃פ

controles.web: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: E vieram Moisés e Arão diante do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הֵרֹ֗מּוּ מִתּוֹךְ֙ הָעֵדָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וַאֲכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם כְּרָ֑גַע וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
controles.kjv: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
controles.livre: Apartai-vos do meio desta congregação, e os consumirei em um momento. E eles se lançaram sobre seus rostos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֣ח אֶת־הַ֠מַּחְתָּה וְתֶן־עָלֶ֨יהָ אֵ֜שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וְשִׂ֣ים קְטֹ֔רֶת וְהוֹלֵ֧ךְ מְהֵרָ֛ה אֶל־הָעֵדָ֖ה וְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־יָצָ֥א הַקֶּ֛צֶף מִלִּפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַנָּֽגֶף׃

controles.web: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun.
controles.livre: E disse Moisés A Arão: Toma o incensário, e põe nele fogo do altar, e sobre ele põe incenso, e vai logo à congregação, e faze expiação por eles; porque o furor saiu de diante da face do SENHOR: a mortandade começou.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיָּ֨רָץ֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹך הַקָּהָ֔ל וְהִנֵּ֛ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַנֶּ֖גֶף בָּעָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶֽת־הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־הָעָֽם׃

controles.web: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. Behold, the plague has begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
controles.kjv: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
controles.livre: Então tomou Arão o incensário, como Moisés disse, e correu em meio da congregação: e eis que a mortandade havia começado no povo: e ele pôs incenso, e fez expiação pelo povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד בֵּֽין־הַמֵּתִ֖ים וּבֵ֣ין הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וַתֵּעָצַ֖ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃

controles.web: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
controles.kjv: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
controles.livre: E pôs-se entre os mortos e os vivos, e cessou a mortandade.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֗וּ הַמֵּתִים֙ בַּמַּגֵּפָ֔ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת מִלְּבַ֥ד הַמֵּתִ֖ים עַל־דְּבַר־קֹֽרַח׃

controles.web: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.
controles.kjv: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
controles.livre: E os que morreram naquela mortandade foram catorze mil e setecentos, sem os mortos pelo negócio de Coré.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤שָׁב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה נֶעֱצָֽרָה׃פ

controles.web: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
controles.kjv: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
controles.livre: Depois se voltou Arão a Moisés à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, quando a mortandade havia cessado.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֣ר׀ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְקַ֣ח מֵֽאִתָּ֡ם מַטֶּ֣ה מַטֶּה֩ לְבֵ֨ית אָ֜ב מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל־נְשִֽׂיאֵהֶם֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מַטּ֑וֹת אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־שְׁמ֔וֹ תִּכְתֹּ֖ב עַל־מַטֵּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e toma deles uma vara por cada casa dos pais, de todos os príncipes deles, doze varas conforme as casas de seus pais; e escreverás o nome de cada um sobre sua vara.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ שֵׁ֣ם אַהֲרֹ֔ן תִּכְתֹּ֖ב עַל־מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֑י כִּ֚י מַטֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד לְרֹ֖אשׁ בֵּ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: You shall write Aaron’s name on the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: E escreverás o nome de Arão sobre a vara de Levi; porque cada cabeça de família de seus pais terá uma vara.

versos.hebraico: וְהִנַּחְתָּ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵי֙ הָֽעֵד֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לָכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
controles.livre: E as porás no tabernáculo do testemunho diante do testemunho, onde eu me declararei a vós.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶבְחַר־בּ֖וֹ מַטֵּ֣הוּ יִפְרָ֑ח וַהֲשִׁכֹּתִ֣י מֵֽעָלַ֗י אֶת־תְּלֻנּוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם מַלִּינִ֖ם עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: It shall happen, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
controles.livre: E será, que o homem que eu escolher, sua vara florescerá: e farei cessar de sobre mim as queixas dos filhos de Israel, com que murmuram contra vós.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֵלָ֣יו׀ כָּֽל־נְשִֽׂיאֵיהֶ֡ם מַטֶּה֩ לְנָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד מַטֶּ֨ה לְנָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מַטּ֑וֹת וּמַטֵּ֥ה אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ מַטּוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.
controles.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
controles.livre: E Moisés falou aos filhos de Israel, e todos os príncipes deles lhe deram varas; cada príncipe pelas casas de seus pais uma vara, em todas doze varas; e a vara de Arão estava entre as varas deles.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּנַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־הַמַּטֹּ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּאֹ֖הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃

controles.web: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the tent of the testimony.
controles.kjv: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.
controles.livre: E Moisés pôs as varas diante do SENHOR no tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיָּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל הָעֵד֔וּת וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּרַ֥ח מַטֵּֽה־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְבֵ֣ית לֵוִ֑י וַיֹּ֤צֵֽא פֶ֨רַח֙ וַיָּ֣צֵֽץ צִ֔יץ וַיִּגְמֹ֖ל שְׁקֵדִֽים׃

controles.web: On the next day, Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que no dia seguinte veio Moisés ao tabernáculo do testemunho; e eis que a vara de Arão da casa de Levi havia brotado, e produzido flores, e lançado renovos, e produzido amêndoas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּטֹּת֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּרְא֥וּ וַיִּקְח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מַטֵּֽהוּ׃ס

controles.web: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.
controles.kjv: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
controles.livre: Então tirou Moisés todas as varas de diante do SENHOR a todos os filhos de Israel; e eles o viram, e tomaram cada um sua vara.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הָשֵׁ֞ב אֶת־מַטֵּ֤ה אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעֵד֔וּת לְמִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵי־מֶ֑רִי וּתְכַ֧ל תְּלוּנֹּתָ֛ם מֵעָלַ֖י וְלֹ֥א יָמֻֽתוּ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their murmurings against me, that they not die.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Volta a vara de Arão diante do testemunho, para que se guarde por sinal aos filhos rebeldes; e farás cessar suas queixas de sobre mim, para que não morram.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס

controles.web: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
controles.kjv: And Moses did so: as the Lord commanded him, so did he.
controles.livre: E o fez Moisés: como lhe mandou o SENHOR, assim fez.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֥ן גָּוַ֛עְנוּ אָבַ֖דְנוּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ אָבָֽדְנוּ׃

controles.web: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
controles.livre: Então os filhos de Israel falaram a Moisés, dizendo: Eis que nós somos mortos, perdidos somos, todos nós somos perdidos.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֣ל הַקָּרֵ֧ב׀ הַקָּרֵ֛ב אֶל־מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה יָמ֑וּת הַאִ֥ם תַּ֖מְנוּ לִגְוֺֽעַ׃ס

controles.web: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”
controles.kjv: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the Lord shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
controles.livre: Qualquer um que se chegar, o que se aproximar ao tabernáculo do SENHOR morrerá: Acabaremos de perecer todos?
